source_title: WW3 Begins THIS MONTH: Israel-Iran War Detonates | Prof. Jiang Xueqin
summary: This interview adds an earlier dated Israel-Iran escalation forecast that joins Hormuz material chokepoints, Iran-as-Eurasian-hinge, imperial pretext logic, prophecy politics, diaspora loyalty sorting, NATO proxy exhaustion, and American institutional war appetite into one high-pressure source.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Hormuz becomes the trapdoor through which a contained Israel-Iran exchange becomes global war.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source directly reprises the Strategy anchor that straits, oil flows, and access gates convert geography into imperial vulnerability.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: World War III is treated as a script some religious actors want to complete in order to force the return of Jesus and the temple sequence.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Jiang frames end-times belief as operational pressure: war, red heifer sacrifice, Al-Aqsa, and the Third Temple become a sequence actors may try to make real.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Secret societies and religious networks inside the security apparatus are described as following compatible end-times scripts rather than a single visible command chain.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source supports the Secret Society boundary where hidden coordination is driven by shared script, institutional placement, and mobilized believers.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Russia, Iran, and China become harder to isolate because Iran is treated as the ultimate imperial test after Ukraine.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The interview strengthens the existing sequencing anchor: visible one-by-one pressure makes Eurasian players rationally hold together.

chronology_notes.note: On 2025-10-07, Jiang forecasts a near-term second Israel-Iran war measured in days or weeks and explicitly distinguishes the earlier 12-day conflict as a test run rather than the real sustained war.

The interview records Jiang's October 2025 view that Israel moved from the forward-looking, liberal, technologically impressive country he visited in May 2012 into a prophetic identity crisis whose remaining believers may fight to the end.

This source sits before later March 2026 live-war formulations and should be treated as an earlier forecast-stage articulation of the Hormuz, red-heifer, Christian-Zionist, and Iran-as-ultimate-test mechanisms.
The closing China forecast is date-sensitive: on 2025-10-07 Jiang reads a U.S. strategy document as a peace signal and predicts a major Trump-Xi rapprochement within three months.
